question: How do obstacles behave in the presence of an accomplished practitioner?
premises: Obstacles flee upon seeing the practitioner.
Elephants flee upon seeing a lion.
The verse draws an explicit comparison between these two cases.
inference: Obstacles disperse before the accomplished practitioner as elephants flee from a lion.
uncertainties: The verse implies but does not name the practitioner as the object seen by obstacles.
plain_english: Obstacles flee on seeing him, just as elephants flee on seeing a lion.
